---
title: "Sign-in Factor Share of Successes"
description: "Each sign-in factor's share of successful second factors, including passkey share."
---

Each sign-in factor's share of the second factors that succeeded over a selected
reporting period. The `fido2` row is the passkey share: of the people who cleared
a second factor at sign-in, how many did it with a passkey.

This is the measure to use for passkey uptake. It compares like with like, a
completed second factor against a completed second factor. The share in
[Sign-in MFA Activity by Factor](sign-in-mfa-activity-by-factor.qmd) does not:
it counts an SMS code as soon as it is sent, entered or not, but a passkey only
once the prompt reaches an outcome, so it understates passkeys.

It covers the factors the public can sign in with: `sms_otp`, `voice_otp`, and
`fido2`. `email_otp` is a sign-up check, not a sign-in factor.

## Calculation

Restrict to the sign-in factors and to `result = 'success'`. Sum `count` by
`mfa_type`, then divide each factor's successes by all sign-in successes.

For a trend, do the same per Monday-to-Sunday week, and leave off any week the
reporting window cuts short: a part week has too few days to compare.

::: {.callout-note collapse="true" title="Example queries"}

::: {.panel-tabset}

## SQL

By factor:

```sql
SELECT
    mfa_type,
    SUM(count) AS successes,
    CAST(SUM(count) AS DOUBLE)
        / NULLIF(SUM(SUM(count)) OVER (), 0) AS share_of_successes
FROM ibm_verify_events_transformed.events_mfa_activity
-- set the reporting window; see the timespans note in cookbook/notes.qmd
WHERE CAST(from_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-01' AND DATE '2026-05-28'
  -- the factors the public can sign in with; email_otp is a sign-up check
  AND mfa_type IN ('sms_otp', 'voice_otp', 'fido2')
  AND result = 'success'
GROUP BY mfa_type
ORDER BY successes DESC;
```

Passkey share by week:

```sql
SELECT
    date_trunc('week', CAST(from_date AS DATE)) AS week_start,
    SUM(count) FILTER (WHERE mfa_type = 'fido2') AS passkey_successes,
    SUM(count) AS successes,
    CAST(SUM(count) FILTER (WHERE mfa_type = 'fido2') AS DOUBLE)
        / NULLIF(SUM(count), 0) AS passkey_share
FROM ibm_verify_events_transformed.events_mfa_activity
-- whole Monday-to-Sunday weeks only: start on a Monday, end on a Sunday
WHERE CAST(from_date AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2026-01-05' AND DATE '2026-05-24'
  AND mfa_type IN ('sms_otp', 'voice_otp', 'fido2')
  AND result = 'success'
-- date_trunc('week', ...) anchors each bin to its Monday
GROUP BY date_trunc('week', CAST(from_date AS DATE))
ORDER BY week_start;
```

## R

By factor:

```r
tbl(con, in_schema("ibm_verify_events_transformed", "events_mfa_activity")) |>
  # set the reporting window; see the timespans note in cookbook/notes.qmd
  filter(
    as.Date(from_date) >= as.Date("2026-01-01"),
    as.Date(from_date) <= as.Date("2026-05-28"),
    # the factors the public can sign in with; email_otp is a sign-up check
    mfa_type %in% c("sms_otp", "voice_otp", "fido2"),
    result == "success"
  ) |>
  group_by(mfa_type) |>
  summarise(successes = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)) |>
  mutate(
    share_of_successes =
      as.double(successes) / sum(successes, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(successes))
```

Passkey share by week:

```r
tbl(con, in_schema("ibm_verify_events_transformed", "events_mfa_activity")) |>
  # whole Monday-to-Sunday weeks only: start on a Monday, end on a Sunday
  filter(
    as.Date(from_date) >= as.Date("2026-01-05"),
    as.Date(from_date) <= as.Date("2026-05-24"),
    mfa_type %in% c("sms_otp", "voice_otp", "fido2"),
    result == "success"
  ) |>
  # floor_date(..., "week") translates to Athena's date_trunc('week', ...),
  # which anchors each bin to its Monday
  mutate(week_start = floor_date(as.Date(from_date), "week")) |>
  group_by(week_start) |>
  summarise(
    passkey_successes =
      sum(if_else(mfa_type == "fido2", count, 0L), na.rm = TRUE),
    successes = sum(count, na.rm = TRUE),
    passkey_share =
      sum(if_else(mfa_type == "fido2", as.double(count), 0), na.rm = TRUE) /
        sum(count, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(week_start)
```

:::

:::

## Interpretation notes

The shares are proportions between 0 and 1 and sum to 1 across the three
factors. Passkeys (`fido2`) became generally available on 2026-07-06, so a window
that starts earlier shows little or no passkey share. A share can rise because
passkey use grew or because SMS use fell; read the share next to the successes
behind it.

## Alternative names

- passkey share
- passkey uptake
- sign-in factor mix
- share of completed second factors
